summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.84/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.84 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 11, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 13¢ lower than a week ago, 47¢ lower than a month ago, and 97¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Fond du Lac ($3.60) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.06).
